lines.t: Yeah…
You said your darkness go deep in your bones,
Now let the Light hit every room in your home.
You say you’re dangerous, you ain’t wrong,
Mind in a cage, heart gone long.
House in sin, that’s on you,
Clean it up now, let YahuShua come through.
Be destroyed in His love, let your ego die,
Fall to the floor, let the old you cry.
No more blame, no mask, no play,
Take full weight of your sin today.
You were raised to be temple, but you played with the dirt,
Turned sacred ground to a playground for hurt.
Flexed on your charm, that boyish face and smile,
While a kingdom of shadows walked you down the aisle.You text in the night, say you’re “sick for a hit,”
Validation in your veins like you fiend for it.
You confess to betray when love feels true,
Now it’s time that the judgment starts with you.You’re scared of that pure love, say it’s “too good,”
So you torch every bridge in the neighborhood.
You’d rather sabotage than sit in the light,
Now Heaven’s at the door sayin’, “Drop the fight.”
You keep pointing at demons like they hold the key,
But the chain on your neck spelled R‑E‑S‑P‑O‑N‑S‑I‑B‑I‑L‑I‑T‑Y.
Own what you did, drag it into the sun,
That’s the only way this war gets won.
You say you’re dangerous, you ain’t wrong,
Mind in a cage, heart gone long.
House in sin, that’s on you,
Clean it up now, let YahuShua come through.
Be destroyed in His love, let your ego die,
Fall to the floor, let the old you cry.
No more blame, no mask, no play,
Take full weight of your sin today.
Your mind tangled up, heart locked in a vault,
Every proud little word just stacking your fault.
You’ve been talking like a king with a hollow crown,
Now that weight on your skull ‘bout to push you down.There’s a day in the fire where your hard shell breaks,
Where your eyes fill with tears and your whole frame shakes.
Not from terror of wrath, but from mercy so raw,
When you finally see the Cross for what you saw.You tell her, “Back up, I’m too broken to touch,”
But distance alone won’t fix that much.
Grace ain’t a license to keep your chains,
It’s the power to snap ‘em and walk from the flames.He walked on the waves with no safety net,
You still gripping your lust like a loaded TEC.
He gave up His life, holding nothing in reserve,
You still rationing out how much you’ll serve.
Time to drop the boy mask, step into the man,
Not by flex in the mirror, but surrendering the plan.
A real one proves strength by letting go,
By losing his life so his spirit can grow.You run out ahead on a fantasy high,
Then crash in the dirt asking “Lord, why?”
Slow down, fall back into His stride,
Let Him lead every step, not your wounded pride.
You say you’re dangerous, you ain’t wrong,
Mind in a cage, heart gone long.
House in sin, that’s on you,
Clean it up now, let YahuShua come through.
Be destroyed in His love, let your ego die,
Fall to the floor, let the old you cry.
No more blame, no mask, no play,
Take full weight of your sin today.
You said if you walk in His light, all dark gets shown,
So why you still hiding like He left you alone?
He already paid for the filth on your skin,
But He’s waiting on you to bring it all in.You’re more than the filth, but don’t twist that line,
‘Cause owning your sin is how grace really shines.
Confess every wound that you turned into knives,
Every woman you used just to feel alive.You talk about trauma, abandonment, fear,
Turned closeness to threat every time love came near.
Now Heaven pulls rank, tells the boy in you, “Die,”
So the son in you rises with fire in his eye.Lead your own house, be the first to obey,
Drop lust, drop excuses, drop games you play.
Let your yes mean yes, let your no stay no,
Let your family see what surrender looks like in the glow.
Yeah, you’re dangerous, but the target is you,
Friendly‑fire heart with a hollow‑point view.
Light on your secrets, judgment inside,
Mercy on the table if you lay down pride.
Be destroyed in His love, let the old you cease,
Stay on your knees till He speaks out “Peace.”
Set your house in order, this your wake‑up call,
Drop the phone, hit the floor, give YahuShua it all.
